name: La_Plaga_Gore_Edition
negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, deformed, cartoon, anime, text, watermark, clean skin, bright colors
common_prompt: extreme horror, graphic gore, hyper-realistic, dark post-apocalyptic, blood and decay, cinematic lighting, gritty texture

scenes.name: intro_1
scenes.prompt: An abandoned office lobby splattered with fresh blood, a smartphone vibrating in a pool of dark red liquid, flickering emergency lights.

scenes.name: intro_2
scenes.prompt: Macro shot of a smartphone screen showing a pulsating, organic black growth that looks like living virus tissue.

scenes.name: intro_3
scenes.prompt: A Wall Street executive with eyes hemorrhaging blood, skin turning a necrotic grey, staring at the glowing device.

scenes.name: intro_4
scenes.prompt: Extreme close-up of black parasitic veins bursting through the skin of a human hand, moving like worms under the flesh.

scenes.name: intro_5
scenes.prompt: The executive vomiting a black, viscous bile, his jaw unhinging unnaturally, neck muscles spasming.

scenes.name: verse1_1
scenes.prompt: The zombie executive dragging a mangled leg, leaving a smear of blood on the polished marble floor, his suit torn to shreds.

scenes.name: verse1_2
scenes.prompt: A janitor trapped in a corner, screaming as a shadow with glowing white eyes and exposed teeth lunges at his throat.

scenes.name: verse1_3
scenes.prompt: Graphic close-up of a throat being torn open, arterial spray hitting a glass door, viscera spilling out.

scenes.name: verse1_4
scenes.prompt: A city street littered with half-eaten corpses, zombies feasting on remains in the middle of the road, entrails visible.

scenes.name: chorus1_1
scenes.prompt: The executive zombie standing on a balcony, blood dripping from his chin, overlooking a city engulfed in black smoke and fire.

scenes.name: chorus1_2
scenes.prompt: Interior of a luxury apartment where a family of zombies huddles over a body, cinematic lighting on the carnage.

scenes.name: chorus1_3
scenes.prompt: Horde of decaying zombies crashing through a plate glass window, shards of glass embedded in their rotting flesh.

scenes.name: chorus1_4
scenes.prompt: A severed arm with a luxury watch still attached, lying in a gutter filled with dark, clotted blood.

scenes.name: verse2_1
scenes.prompt: A line of shambling corpses in suits, their faces partially missing, jawbones exposed, walking through a bloody mist.

scenes.name: verse2_2
scenes.prompt: Macro shot of a zombie's face as the flesh sloughs off, revealing the raw skull and wet muscle beneath.

scenes.name: verse2_3
scenes.prompt: A blood-stained swing set in a playground, a small zombie child holding a tattered, bloody teddy bear.

scenes.name: verse2_4
scenes.prompt: Aerial shot of a pile of bodies burning in a highway intersection, charred limbs and smoke.

scenes.name: chorus2_1
scenes.prompt: The executive zombie standing atop a pyramid of skulls and office equipment, holding a severed head.

scenes.name: chorus2_2
scenes.prompt: A rain of blood falling over a crowd of thousands of snarling, hungry zombies in a dark plaza.

scenes.name: chorus2_3
scenes.prompt: Zombies with their eyes sewn shut, sensing movement, their bodies covered in ritualistic scars and gore.

scenes.name: chorus2_4
scenes.prompt: A wall of human faces merged into a fleshy mass, pulsating with the black virus, glowing green light.

scenes.name: verse3_1
scenes.prompt: Subway stairs overflowing with a tide of zombies, blood cascading down the steps like a waterfall.

scenes.name: verse3_2
scenes.prompt: A surgical room where a partially dissected zombie is getting up from the table, organs swinging.

scenes.name: verse3_3
scenes.prompt: Close-up of a zombie's mouth, teeth yellow and broken, biting into a raw piece of meat with extreme violence.

scenes.name: verse3_4
scenes.prompt: A shoreline where the tide is bringing in thousands of bloated, waterlogged corpses.

scenes.name: chorus3_1
scenes.prompt: Zombies tied to the front of moving cars, used as macabre ornaments, screaming into the wind.

scenes.name: chorus3_2
scenes.prompt: A boardroom where zombie directors are eating a human on the table, blood splashing on the documents.

scenes.name: chorus3_3
scenes.prompt: A zombie's hand reaching through a chest cavity, pulling out a still-beating, blackened heart.

scenes.name: chorus3_4
scenes.prompt: Wide shot of the moon turning blood-red as the Earth below is consumed by a sea of fire and flesh.

scenes.name: bridge_1
scenes.prompt: Rapid montage of flesh tearing, bones snapping, and black liquid filling veins.

scenes.name: bridge_2
scenes.prompt: A nurse zombie with a missing jaw, holding a rusted bone saw in a dark, bloody infirmary.

scenes.name: bridge_3
scenes.prompt: Rows of human heads kept in jars, their eyes still moving, connected to glowing green wires.

scenes.name: bridge_4
scenes.prompt: A fountain in a park spraying pure blood, surrounded by kneeling, mutated figures.

scenes.name: solo_1
scenes.prompt: Fast motion: a zombie mutating, growing extra limbs and spines from its back in a spray of blood.

scenes.name: solo_2
scenes.prompt: The zombie executive ripping his own chest open to reveal a pulsating, glowing core.

scenes.name: solo_3
scenes.prompt: A skyscraper collapsing, and from the dust, a giant monstrosity made of stitched bodies emerges.

scenes.name: solo_4
scenes.prompt: Deep sea: a shark being torn apart by a swarm of aquatic, rotted zombies.

scenes.name: verse_reprise_1
scenes.prompt: The executive's assistant, now a zombie, crawling on the ceiling with unnaturally long fingers.

scenes.name: verse_reprise_2
scenes.prompt: A silver platter on a desk holding a human brain, surrounded by high-end office supplies.

scenes.name: verse_reprise_3
scenes.prompt: Zombies skinning themselves alive in a ritualistic circle, raw muscle gleaming in the dark.

scenes.name: verse_reprise_4
scenes.prompt: A hand with no skin pressing an elevator button, leaving a wet, red print.

scenes.name: final_chorus_1
scenes.prompt: A stadium where a massive pile of living flesh is pulsating, absorbing thousands of zombies.

scenes.name: final_chorus_2
scenes.prompt: Black, oily rain melting the skin off the few remaining humans in a dark alley.

scenes.name: final_chorus_3
scenes.prompt: The executive zombie standing on the edge of a crater, his body now a mass of tentacles and gore.

scenes.name: final_chorus_4
scenes.prompt: Extreme close-up of a zombie's mouth opening wide, revealing rows of needle-like teeth and a second jaw.

scenes.name: outro_1
scenes.prompt: The smartphone screen cracks, and a small, fleshy tentacle crawls out of the glass.

scenes.name: outro_2
scenes.prompt: Trees in a forest covered in human skin, the leaves replaced by fingernails.

scenes.name: outro_3
scenes.prompt: A vast desert made of ground bone, a single ribcage sticking out of the ground.

scenes.name: outro_4
scenes.prompt: The sun eclipsed by a giant, organic mass of flesh floating in orbit.

scenes.name: outro_5
scenes.prompt: A grainy video of the executive's family being devoured, appearing for a split second.

scenes.name: outro_6
scenes.prompt: A single eye opening in the middle of a black screen, the pupil shaped like a biohazard symbol.

scenes.name: outro_7
scenes.prompt: Final shot: The title 'LA PLAGA' written in dripping, wet blood against a wall of human flesh.
